::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 9th [1867]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 183-184
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
I send up the two next chapters of [St John](cmy_books/cmybook_72.qmd), in case it should be convenient to show [Mr Armitage](people/person_60.qmd) the description of the scene with the Robber. Do you mean to have [vignettes](organizations/other_167.qmd)? If you do the cup with the serpent should come at the end of the last chapter I send you, and the one I am writing now should have the golden candlestick, I should try for Diana for the first if the Ephesian Diana were not so frightful.

I suppose [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd)’s call on you was not accomplished. It was to depend on whether she decided on going to the Paris exhibition 

I am sorry she did not manage it, as it would have saved time

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

Thanks for the [Pall Mall Gazette](organizations/other_192.qmd), I thought it the most dangerous so I hope the others will be as polite[^1]

---

[^1]: The *Pall Mall Gazette* (2 July 1867), 11, reviewed *The Danvers Papers* in appreciative if slightly patronizing terms.
